question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Melancholy
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Melancholy"** means a deep, persistent sadness or gloom. (उदासी)

 
 
• **Example:** After the funeral, a sense of** melancholy **settled over the household.
 
 
 
• **"Cheerful"** refers to being noticeably happy and optimistic. (प्रसन्न)
 
 
• **Example:** Her **cheerful** attitude always brightens up the room.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Melancholy'** is **'Cheerful'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sorrow** (शोक): A feeling of deep distress caused by loss, disappointment, or other misfortune.

 
 
• **Example:** The sorrow of losing his pet was overwhelming.
 
 
 
• **Blue** (उदास): Informally, it means feeling sad or depressed.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt blue after hearing the bad news.
 
 
 
• **Sad** (दुखी): Feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy.
 
 
• **Example:** He looked sad when he heard about the accident.
